clans.name: Vanguard Branch 1

A branch's value is demonstrated by Clan Capability Factor Two, clan merit and the ability to defeat rival branches at comparable or more prestigious recursion depths.

structure: An immediate branch of the Redalious main clan within the recursively extensible Benzshin branch architecture.
Branch-clan descendants can themselves enter Benzshin and generate branch-of-branch clans without a terminal recursion depth.
High merit can move members toward the main clan; poor relative merit can move them farther down the recursive branch ladder.
performance: Source labels it the most successful immediate Redalious branch and places it within the apex Top-10 clan ranking set.

Its ranking exists inside the same violently volatile proxy-war system in which even a 674th-recursive Unmatara branch defeating a 76th-recursive Redalious branch is treated as a major superiority proof.
Branch victories feed clan merit and the wider Redalious improvement architecture.
members: Named individual leader and roster are not established in the reviewed transmission.
relationships: Primary systemic rivalry: Unmatara recursive branches, especially under Redalious–Unmatara proxy-war comparison.
unknowns: Current rank after later clan-ranking changes
